chapterInfo.content:
16
Kora, Datan ne Abiram atuateɛ
1 # Eks 6.18, 21; Num 26.9; Yuda 11 Kora a n’agya ne Isehar a ɔyɛ Lewi ba Kohat ba no ne Eliab mma Datan, Abiram ne Pelet ba On a wɔfiri Ruben abusua mu, faa nnipa bi, 2#Num 12.1-2 na wɔne Israelfoɔ mu mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔyɛ asafo no mu mmapɔmma a wɔayi wɔn sɛ abadwafoɔ, nnipa a wɔwɔ din sɔre tiaa Mose; 3na wɔbɔɔ Mose ne Aaron so dwa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ayɛ yie! Asafo mu yi nyinaa yɛ nnipa kronkron, obiara biara na AWURADE wɔ wɔn mu, na adɛn nti na moma mo ho so AWURADE badwa soɔ? 4#Num 14.5 Na Mose teeɛ no, ɔde n’anim butuu fam; 5#2 Ti 2.19 na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Kora ne n’asefoɔ no nyinaa sɛ: Anɔpa, AWURADE bɛma wɔahunu deɛ ɔyɛ ne deɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron a ɔbɛma no abɛn no; na deɛ ɔbɛfa no no, ɔno na ɔbɛma no abɛn no. 6Yei na monyɛ: Kora ne n’asafo no nyinaa, momfa aduhwam nkukuwa, 7na momfa ogya ngu mu, na momfa aduhwam ngu so, AWURADE anim, ɔkyena. Na ɛbɛba sɛ onipa a AWURADE bɛyi no no, ɔbɛyɛ kronkron. Afei deɛ, ayɛ yie, mo Lewi mma! 8Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Mo Lewi mma, montie me ɛ! 9#Num 3.6-13; 4.4-20 Ɛyɛ mo ade ketewa sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no ate mo afiri Israel asafo ho sɛ ɔde mo rebɛn ne ho na moayɛ AWURADE tenabea no ho adwuma, na moagyina asafo no anim asom wɔn? 10Na wama wo ne wo nuanom Lewi mma a wɔka wo ho nyinaa abɛn no, na morepɛ asɔfodie nso yi? 11#Eks 16.7 Enti AWURADE na wo ne w’asafo nyinaa ahyia atia no; na Aaron deɛ, hwan ne no na monwiinwii tia no?
12Na Mose soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram; na wɔse: Yɛremma! 13Ɛyɛ adewa sɛ woayi yɛn afiri asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ so rebɛku yɛn ɛserɛ soɔ, na woredi yɛn so abakomasɛm nso yi? 14#Eks 3.8, 17 Nso womfaa yɛn mmaa asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ so, na wommaa yɛn mfuo ne nturo sɛ yɛnni so; na mmarima yi aniwa na worebɛtutuo? Yɛremma!
15 # 1 Sa 12.3; Aso 20.33 Ɛnna Mose bo fuu pii, na ɔka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Nnane w’ani nkyerɛ wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ. Mennyee wɔn nsam afunumu baako mpo, nso menyɛɛ wɔn mu biara bɔne bi. 16Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Wo ne w’asafo no nyinaa mmra AWURADE anim, wo ne wɔn ne Aaron mmra ɔkyena; 17na mo mu biara mfa ne kukuwa, na ɔmfa aduhwam ngu mu, na obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra AWURADE anim, nkukuwa ahanu aduonum; na wo nso, ne Aaron, obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra. 18Na wɔn mu obiara faa ne kukuwa, na wɔsosoo gya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhwam guguu so de bɛgyinagyinaa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, wɔne Mose ne Aaron. 19#Num 14.10 Na Kora maa asafo mu no nyinaa bɔɔ wɔn so dwa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ asafo mu no nyinaa.
20Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: 21Montwe mo ho mfiri asafo yi mu, na memmene wɔn amonom. 22#Hiob 12.10; 2 Sa 24.17 Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn a woyɛ honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn! Ɔbarima baako bɛyɛ bɔne na wo bo afu asafo mu no nyinaa? 23Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ asafo no sɛ: 24Montwe mo ho mfiri Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho.
25Na Mose sɔre sii mu kɔɔ Datan ne Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanimfoɔ dii n’akyi kɔe. 26Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfiri nnipa abɔnefoɔ yi ntomadan ho ɛ, na monnka wɔn biribiara, na wɔampra mo ne wɔn bɔne nyinaa ankɔ. 27Na wɔtwee wɔn ho firii Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho. Na Datan ne Abiram firii adi bɛgyinagyinaa wɔn ntomadan ano, wɔne wɔn yerenom, wɔn mma ne wɔn mmotafowa nyinaa. 28Na Mose kaa sɛ: Yei na mode bɛhunu sɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me sɛ menyɛ nneyɛɛ yi nyinaa, na ɛmfiri me ara: 29Sɛdeɛ nnipa nyinaa wuo na yeinom bɛwuwuo na deɛ ɛto nnipa nyinaa na ɛto wɔn a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me; 30na sɛ ade foforɔ na AWURADE bɛbɔ na asase bɛbue n’ano amene wɔn ne deɛ ɛwɔ wɔn nyinaa na wɔnam anikan asiane akɔ Asamando a, ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ mmarima yi abu AWURADE animtia.
31 # Deut 11.6 Na ɔwiee nsɛm yi nyinaa ka no, wɔn ase asase paee, 32na asase buee n’ano menee wɔn ne wɔn afie ne nnipa a wɔkaa Kora ho no nyinaa ne wɔn ade nyinaa; 33na wɔne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa nam anikan siane kɔɔ Asamando, na asase sram wɔn so, na wɔyeraa wɔ ɔman asafo no mu. 34Na Israelfoɔ a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no nyinaa dwanee wɔ wɔn gyegyeegye no ano, kaa sɛ: Anyɛ a asase bɛmene yɛn nso! 35#Lew 10.1-2; Dwom 106.18 Na ogya firi AWURADE nkyɛn bɛhyee mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔde aduhwam no baeɛ no.
36Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 37Ka kyerɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa, na ɔntase nkukuwa no mfiri nhyeeɛ no mu, na dwiri ogya no petepete; na ɛyɛ kronkron: 38Nnebɔneyɛfoɔ yi a wɔayɛ wɔn kra ho bɔne nkukuwa no, na mommoro nyɛ abena atɛtrɛtɛ nkata afɔrebukyia no ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde baa AWURADE anim, na ayɛ kronkron, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma Israelfoɔ no. 39Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa faa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nkukuwa a wɔn a wɔahyeɛ no de baeɛ no, na wɔboro de yɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nkataho, 40#Num 1.51 sɛ ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na onipa foforɔ a ɔmfiri Aaron asefoɔ mu no ammɛn ammɛhye aduhwam AWURADE anim, na anyɛ no sɛ Kora ne n’asafo no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ no no.
41Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Israel asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Mo na moakum AWURADE nkurɔfoɔ. 42#Num 14.10 Na asafo no boaboaa wɔn ano tiaa Mose ne Aaron no, wɔdanedanee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no, na hwɛ, na mununkum no akata so, na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho adi. 43Na Mose ne Aaron baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim. 44Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 45#Num 16.4, 22 Monsɔre mfiri asafo yi mu na memmene wɔn amonom. Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam.
46 # Eks 28.38; Lew 16.13 Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa kukuwa no, na so afɔrebukyia no so gya gu mu, na yɛ ntɛm fa kɔ asafo no nkyɛn kɔpata ma wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ abufuhyeɛ afiri AWURADE anim afi. Ɔyaredɔm no afiri aseɛ. 47Na Aaron faa deɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na ɔtuu mmirika kɔɔ asafo no mu; na hwɛ, na ɔyaredɔm no afiri aseɛ ɔman no mu; na ɔde aduhwam no mae de pata maa ɔman no. 48Na ɔgyinaa awufoɔ ne anikanfoɔ no ntam, na wɔsii ɔyaredɔm no ano. 49Na nnipa a wɔwuwuu ɔyaredɔm no mu ano si mpem dunan ne ahanson, ɛsono wɔn a Kora asɛm no nti wɔwuiɛ no. 50Na ɔyaredɔm no to twaeɛ no, Aaron sane baa Mose nkyɛn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

pageProps.chapterText:
Kora a n’agya ne Isehar a ɔyɛ Lewi ba Kohat ba no ne Eliab mma Datan, Abiram ne Pelet ba On a wɔfiri Ruben abusua mu, faa nnipa bi, na wɔne Israelfoɔ mu mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔyɛ asafo no mu mmapɔmma a wɔayi wɔn sɛ abadwafoɔ, nnipa a wɔwɔ din sɔre tiaa Mose; na wɔbɔɔ Mose ne Aaron so dwa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ayɛ yie! Asafo mu yi nyinaa yɛ nnipa kronkron, obiara biara na AWURADE wɔ wɔn mu, na adɛn nti na moma mo ho so AWURADE badwa soɔ? Na Mose teeɛ no, ɔde n’anim butuu fam; na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Kora ne n’asefoɔ no nyinaa sɛ: Anɔpa, AWURADE bɛma wɔahunu deɛ ɔyɛ ne deɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron a ɔbɛma no abɛn no; na deɛ ɔbɛfa no no, ɔno na ɔbɛma no abɛn no. Yei na monyɛ: Kora ne n’asafo no nyinaa, momfa aduhwam nkukuwa, na momfa ogya ngu mu, na momfa aduhwam ngu so, AWURADE anim, ɔkyena. Na ɛbɛba sɛ onipa a AWURADE bɛyi no no, ɔbɛyɛ kronkron. Afei deɛ, ayɛ yie, mo Lewi mma! Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Mo Lewi mma, montie me ɛ! Ɛyɛ mo ade ketewa sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no ate mo afiri Israel asafo ho sɛ ɔde mo rebɛn ne ho na moayɛ AWURADE tenabea no ho adwuma, na moagyina asafo no anim asom wɔn? Na wama wo ne wo nuanom Lewi mma a wɔka wo ho nyinaa abɛn no, na morepɛ asɔfodie nso yi? Enti AWURADE na wo ne w’asafo nyinaa ahyia atia no; na Aaron deɛ, hwan ne no na monwiinwii tia no?
Na Mose soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram; na wɔse: Yɛremma! Ɛyɛ adewa sɛ woayi yɛn afiri asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ so rebɛku yɛn ɛserɛ soɔ, na woredi yɛn so abakomasɛm nso yi? Nso womfaa yɛn mmaa asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ so, na wommaa yɛn mfuo ne nturo sɛ yɛnni so; na mmarima yi aniwa na worebɛtutuo? Yɛremma!
Ɛnna Mose bo fuu pii, na ɔka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Nnane w’ani nkyerɛ wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ. Mennyee wɔn nsam afunumu baako mpo, nso menyɛɛ wɔn mu biara bɔne bi. Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Kora sɛ: Wo ne w’asafo no nyinaa mmra AWURADE anim, wo ne wɔn ne Aaron mmra ɔkyena; na mo mu biara mfa ne kukuwa, na ɔmfa aduhwam ngu mu, na obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra AWURADE anim, nkukuwa ahanu aduonum; na wo nso, ne Aaron, obiara mfa ne kukuwa mmra. Na wɔn mu obiara faa ne kukuwa, na wɔsosoo gya guguu mu, na wɔde aduhwam guguu so de bɛgyinagyinaa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, wɔne Mose ne Aaron. Na Kora maa asafo mu no nyinaa bɔɔ wɔn so dwa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho kyerɛɛ asafo mu no nyinaa.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfiri asafo yi mu, na memmene wɔn amonom. Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn a woyɛ honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn! Ɔbarima baako bɛyɛ bɔne na wo bo afu asafo mu no nyinaa? Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ asafo no sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfiri Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho.
Na Mose sɔre sii mu kɔɔ Datan ne Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanimfoɔ dii n’akyi kɔe. Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: Montwe mo ho mfiri nnipa abɔnefoɔ yi ntomadan ho ɛ, na monnka wɔn biribiara, na wɔampra mo ne wɔn bɔne nyinaa ankɔ. Na wɔtwee wɔn ho firii Kora, Datan ne Abiram tenabea ho. Na Datan ne Abiram firii adi bɛgyinagyinaa wɔn ntomadan ano, wɔne wɔn yerenom, wɔn mma ne wɔn mmotafowa nyinaa. Na Mose kaa sɛ: Yei na mode bɛhunu sɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me sɛ menyɛ nneyɛɛ yi nyinaa, na ɛmfiri me ara: Sɛdeɛ nnipa nyinaa wuo na yeinom bɛwuwuo na deɛ ɛto nnipa nyinaa na ɛto wɔn a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔsomaa me; na sɛ ade foforɔ na AWURADE bɛbɔ na asase bɛbue n’ano amene wɔn ne deɛ ɛwɔ wɔn nyinaa na wɔnam anikan asiane akɔ Asamando a, ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ mmarima yi abu AWURADE animtia.
Na ɔwiee nsɛm yi nyinaa ka no, wɔn ase asase paee, na asase buee n’ano menee wɔn ne wɔn afie ne nnipa a wɔkaa Kora ho no nyinaa ne wɔn ade nyinaa; na wɔne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa nam anikan siane kɔɔ Asamando, na asase sram wɔn so, na wɔyeraa wɔ ɔman asafo no mu. Na Israelfoɔ a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no nyinaa dwanee wɔ wɔn gyegyeegye no ano, kaa sɛ: Anyɛ a asase bɛmene yɛn nso! Na ogya firi AWURADE nkyɛn bɛhyee mmarima ahanu aduonum a wɔde aduhwam no baeɛ no.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa, na ɔntase nkukuwa no mfiri nhyeeɛ no mu, na dwiri ogya no petepete; na ɛyɛ kronkron: Nnebɔneyɛfoɔ yi a wɔayɛ wɔn kra ho bɔne nkukuwa no, na mommoro nyɛ abena atɛtrɛtɛ nkata afɔrebukyia no ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde baa AWURADE anim, na ayɛ kronkron, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma Israelfoɔ no. Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa faa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nkukuwa a wɔn a wɔahyeɛ no de baeɛ no, na wɔboro de yɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nkataho, sɛ ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na onipa foforɔ a ɔmfiri Aaron asefoɔ mu no ammɛn ammɛhye aduhwam AWURADE anim, na anyɛ no sɛ Kora ne n’asafo no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so ka kyerɛɛ no no.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Israel asafo no nyinaa nwiinwii tiaa Mose ne Aaron sɛ: Mo na moakum AWURADE nkurɔfoɔ. Na asafo no boaboaa wɔn ano tiaa Mose ne Aaron no, wɔdanedanee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no, na hwɛ, na mununkum no akata so, na AWURADE animuonyam yii ne ho adi. Na Mose ne Aaron baa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim. Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Monsɔre mfiri asafo yi mu na memmene wɔn amonom. Na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam.
Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron sɛ: Fa kukuwa no, na so afɔrebukyia no so gya gu mu, na yɛ ntɛm fa kɔ asafo no nkyɛn kɔpata ma wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ abufuhyeɛ afiri AWURADE anim afi. Ɔyaredɔm no afiri aseɛ. Na Aaron faa deɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na ɔtuu mmirika kɔɔ asafo no mu; na hwɛ, na ɔyaredɔm no afiri aseɛ ɔman no mu; na ɔde aduhwam no mae de pata maa ɔman no. Na ɔgyinaa awufoɔ ne anikanfoɔ no ntam, na wɔsii ɔyaredɔm no ano. Na nnipa a wɔwuwuu ɔyaredɔm no mu ano si mpem dunan ne ahanson, ɛsono wɔn a Kora asɛm no nti wɔwuiɛ no. Na ɔyaredɔm no to twaeɛ no, Aaron sane baa Mose nkyɛn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
